purpose: Use every pnpm ast lens as both a codebase-cleanup instrument and a live validation of the instrument itself. Preserve every finding and ruling, repair false-clean and false-positive behavior at the tool boundary, and leave each valid codebase finding fixed, intentionally governed, assigned to an owner decision, or represented by a precise work item.
objective: Finish the AST/codebase audit against the current shared tree without losing earlier receipts, agent findings, or owner rulings. The canonical ledger is the control plane: every current pnpm ast verb, run, finding, tool defect, disposition, work item, repair, review, and remaining proof obligation must be represented there with stable source pointers.

tasks.work: Reconcile all durable reports, temporary world-tools receipts, the 63-row launch inventory, root transcript, and child-agent transcripts into the canonical ledger. Each source claim must be mapped to a finding or retained in an explicit ingestion backlog with a reason; nothing may disappear because it was only in chat or /tmp.

Run and adjudicate the exact 30-verb pnpm ast denominator recorded in the ledger. Each lens needs a meaningful current-tree scope or target, a complete machine-readable receipt with scan counts and truncation status, and a result classification. A generic invocation that cannot answer the lens question does not settle the row.

For every false-clean, false-positive, corpus, provenance, alias, barrel, test-only, schema-twin, world/tsconfig, or output-accounting defect found while running the lenses, plant a red control, repair the production tool, preserve a healthy witness, and rerun the affected real-tree lens once after the focused controls pass.

Repair the two independently reproduced AppRouter false-clean paths: ordinary direct routeTrpc fixtures must derive procedure key, responder input, and success output from AppRouter without an opt-in wrapper; clientgap provenance must follow a procedure-specific declaration or call edge and must not suppress unrelated contracts through global structural assignability. Keep both rows open until planted controls, focused verification, one final whole-tree clientgap run, and independent rereview confirm them.
tasks.result: Fresh-context review confirmed direct routeTrpc AppRouter fidelity, broad-spread refusal, procedure-specific clientgap provenance, bounded performance, focused controls, policy conformance, and a complete current-tree whole-repo clientgap run.

tasks.work: For each valid finding, inspect architecture and history, corroborate structural absence with ast-grep over TS and TSX plus literal search before deletion, then choose exactly one disposition: implement/fix, wire missing intended behavior, remove proven dead code, preserve governed/public/external/test seam, file precise work, or obtain an owner ruling. Never invent a consumer or weaken a gate to clear a row.

Keep the inference step-9 gaps visible as launch work. The four newly filed rows are one coherent future inference/client implementation and review deployment, while their row-level acceptance evidence remains distinct.

Run affected native type programs and focused behavioral tests, retain red-first receipts, and obtain independent correctness, security, or UX review according to the changed surface. A passing broad run does not override a reproduced counterexample.

Audit all 347 final policies for package/tooling/test reach, expose the canonical planner through structure, repair valid unpopulated resource planning, make Biome naming conventions explicit under override replacement semantics, and retain unresolved architecture rulings as decision briefs.
tasks.ownerDirection: Choose the complete structural solution even when it requires more work; no remaining architecture fork in this batch is awaiting owner preference.

completionCriteria: The canonical ledger enumerates all 30 current pnpm ast verbs and records a settled current-tree run or an explicit, bounded reason the lens cannot be settled.
Every durable receipt, temporary receipt root, launch-inventory row, and transcript claim is mapped or explicitly retained for review; there are no silent or uncounted sources.
Every normalized finding has one current disposition with evidence: resolved, preserved by named law, precise work item, owner decision, or bounded blocked state with a wake condition.
Every confirmed tool defect has a discriminating red-first control, a production repair, a healthy witness, and a post-repair real-tree receipt.
The AppRouter fixture and clientgap blockers are independently rereviewed as confirmed before #2533 or #2551 is landed.
Substantial and security-sensitive repairs have independent review receipts, and the ledger links those verdicts.
The final reconciliation report validates stable IDs, source pointers, denominators, finding counts, and zero unexplained loss from earlier audit stages.
constraints: Prefer accuracy and completeness over speed; do not weaken a lens or shrink its evidence plane to make it green.
Use Code Mod Kit for mechanical migrations when applicable; do not hand-edit broad repetitive changes.
Before deleting based on non-presence, corroborate pnpm ast with ast-grep over TS and TSX and a literal search, recording scanned scope and counts.
Do not use in-repository planted violations; use the verify-style temporary plant system or in-memory authored corpora and prove cleanup.
Do not mutate the live database or push. Main integration requires fresh owner authorization; the owner granted it for this audited checkpoint on 2026-09-21.
